data.title: 陈千语 · 机械工坊的指间相扣
data.description: 深夜的装备维修车间里，焊枪与火花早已熄灭。千语擦干净指尖残留的机油，靠在工作台旁微微喘息。当管理员的手指轻轻包裹住她长年握剑而生有薄茧的右手时，这位平日里严谨果决的干员眼睫微颤，主动收拢五指，与对方深深相扣。
data.action: interlocking fingers with work gloves off, blushing slightly, leaning on bench
data.lighting: industrial work light focused on workshop table
data.promptProse: Resting against the heavy metal workbench in the quiet engineering hangar, Chen Qianyu removes her work gloves. She blushes softly as her calloused warrior fingers interlock with the Administrator's hand under the focused overhead spotlight.
data.animaCaption: Qianyu interlocking fingers tenderly beside the hangar workbench.
